description: Biometric verification wizard that captures client face images, processes a selected national identification document (INE, Passport, or Driver License), validates the face match against the ID using Azure Face API, and records legal contract agreement.

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of identification document provided by the client. Allowed values: INE, Passport, Driver License.

fields.name: idFrontImageBlobUrl
fields.description: Azure Blob Storage URL of the captured front side of the identification document.

fields.name: clientSelfieBlobUrl
fields.description: Azure Blob Storage URL of the live client camera selfie used for facial validation.

fields.name: confidenceScore
fields.description: The matching confidence rating returned by the face verification AI model. Stored as decimal(5,4), e.g. 0.9834.

fields.name: isVerified
fields.description: Flags whether the biometric verification passed the system threshold requirements.

fields.name: contractAccepted
fields.description: Explicit flag indicating the client agreed to the contract terms during the wizard process.

fields.name: acceptedAt
fields.description: Timestamp recording exactly when the contract terms were accepted.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.

components.name: DocumentSelectionStep
components.description: IonRadioGroup letting the user select documentType from: INE, Passport, or Driver License.

components.name: CameraCaptureStep
components.description: Capacitor Camera interface capturing two separate images: idFrontImageBlobUrl (document front) and clientSelfieBlobUrl (live selfie).

components.name: BiometricVerificationStep
components.description: Calls the verify endpoint, displays matching progress, then shows confidenceScore and isVerified result. IonLoading while the API call is in flight.

components.name: ContractAgreementStep
components.description: Displays contract terms in a scrollable IonContent block. IonCheckbox bound to contractAccepted. Submit button calls the contract endpoint and records acceptedAt.

endpoints.description: Accepts idFrontImageBlobUrl and clientSelfieBlobUrl, calls Azure Face API verify, computes confidenceScore, sets isVerified based on threshold >= 0.80, and returns both values.
Persists the completed session (documentType, blob URLs, confidenceScore, isVerified, contractAccepted, acceptedAt) to the database via sp_clientFaceRecognitions.
